name: AlphaBind PEM held-out antigen, pairwise accuracy
description: Pairwise accuracy on antibody pairs against the held-out antigen PEM: the fraction of sampled pairs in which the stronger binder is identified.

attributes.protocol: AlphaBind PEM held out; pairwise accuracy (%)
attributes.metric_qualifier: pairwise: stronger binder identified within sampled antibody pairs
limitations: The authors developed MochiBind and ran all baselines.
Boltz-2 and GeoDock are scored through interface confidence (ipLDDT) used as an affinity proxy, not an affinity head.
The p-values printed beside MochiBind are one-sided McNemar tests against the baselines; no uncertainty is printed for the accuracies.

The four columns are not matched on adaptation: the Graphinity column is the authors' own fine-tune of a third-party model, trained on the same rotation, while Boltz-2 and GeoDock are used without any fitting.

evidence_concerns.message: The Table 2 footnote says "Values denote chi-squared statistics, with significance levels in parentheses", which contradicts the column headers ("Pairwise accuracy (%)", "Graphinity (%)" and so on), the cell contents (percentages between 47.11 and 74.27) and the body text, which places the chi-squared statistics in Table S1. The records read the cells as accuracies with a p-value, which the headers and body support; the footnote is wrong as printed.
